references.text: The laws concerning ritual purity and how to handle bodily discharges that are unclean, including instructions to wash and remain unclean until evening.
The command to send unclean persons out of the camp to keep the camp holy, reflecting the same principle of purity in God's presence.
The command to be holy because the Lord is holy, which is the theological basis for purity laws, including sanitary regulations in the camp.
Ezekiel is told to bake bread over human excrement, later changed to cow dung, showing how important it was to keep waste separate from food and living areas.
